name: CreateRandomText
label: Create Random Text
description: Generates a text of specified length consisting of random characters.

fields.name: MinimumLength
fields.label: Minimum Length
fields.description: The minimum length of the random text to generate.

fields.name: MaximumLength
fields.label: Maximum Length
fields.description: The maximum length of the random text to generate.

fields.name: UseUppercaseLetters
fields.label: Use Uppercase Letters
fields.description: If true, includes uppercase letters (A-Z) in the generated text.

fields.name: UseLowercaseLetters
fields.label: Use Lowercase Letters
fields.description: If true, includes lowercase letters (a-z) in the generated text.

fields.name: UseDigits
fields.label: Use Digits
fields.description: If true, includes digits (0-9) in the generated text.

fields.name: UseSymbols
fields.label: Use Symbols
fields.description: If true, includes symbols (!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>? ) in the generated text.
